title: lIocos Sur students protest Pax Silica, Trump visit

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—Holding placards bearing messages such as “Reject Pax Silica” and “Trump Out,” students from various schools gathered outside the University of Northern Philippines (UNP) in Vigan City on Tuesday, Nov. 17, to protest the proposed US-led initiative and the visit of US President Donald Trump. Led by the Alliance of Concerned Students–Ilocos Sur (ACSIS), the demonstrators called for the protection of the country’s land, livelihoods and natural resources, expressing solidarity with Aeta communities, farmers and future generations they believe could be affected by the project.
